Ask to Buy system behavior vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Family Sharing parental controls cover storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate purchase-approval behavior from product-page copy:

  • Ask to Buy (购买前询问) — per-child toggle under Settings → [your name] → Family Sharing → Ask to Buy. When on, the child's App Store, iTunes Store, and in-app purchase requests route to the family organizer for approval or decline. Controls whether purchases complete — does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Child Apple ID in Family Sharing — Ask to Buy applies to child accounts in the family group (typically under 18). Listing copy may reference child-safe buying; account setup is outside AppLocale scope.
  • Organizer approval notification — parent receives a request on their device to approve or decline before the child's purchase charges. Marketing frames often show approve-or-decline mockups — listing copy names the workflow; notification plumbing is outside Connect metadata scope.
  • Purchase Sharing (different) — shared family payment method for purchases the organizer already approved. A separate Family Sharing surface — not the Ask to Buy approval gate this page covers.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Ask to Buy support in your app marketing.

Working Ask to Buy–friendly workflows or child-safe IAP UX in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Ask to Buy, parental purchase approval, and child-safe buying on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you configure Family Sharing in Settings or implement purchase gates in code.

Ask to Buy–specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Parental purchase-approval marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese parents describe Ask to Buy workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Ask to Buy vs Family Sharing hub phrasing

US pages use "Ask to Buy", "Parental approval for purchases", or "Works with Family Sharing." China storefront copy often uses 购买前询问 for Apple's Ask to Buy feature name under Family Sharing settings, 家长批准购买 when the gallery shows approve-or-decline flows, or 儿童购买需家长同意 for child-account purchase gates — depending on whether you mean the system Ask to Buy switch or generic family purchase safety. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual marketing scope and avoids conflating Ask to Buy with Share with Family family-plan overlays.

Ask to Buy vs Screen Time parental controls

Ask to Buy gates App Store, iTunes, and in-app purchase charges until a parent approves — buyers searching for purchase approval distinguish this from Screen Time Downtime (停用时间), App Limits (App 限额), and Communication Limits (通信限额). Match what your English listing and screenshots actually show.

购买前询问 vs 屏幕使用时间

Apple's Chinese UI uses 购买前询问 for Ask to Buy under Family Sharing and 屏幕使用时间 for Screen Time usage dashboards. Listing copy should pick the term parents recognize on screenshots — an Ask to Buy settings frame needs 购买前询问-friendly phrasing; a usage-limit dashboard frame belongs on the Screen Time guide, not here.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need parental-purchase search terms Chinese parents type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 购买前询问, 家长批准, and 儿童购买 each signal different intent from Screen Time, Family Sharing hub, or Kids category keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Ask to Buy" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Why machine-translated Ask to Buy copy fails

  • Literal "Ask to Buy" → awkward transliteration instead of commerce-idiomatic 购买前询问 or buyer-friendly 家长批准购买
  • Generic "Parental controls" → 家长控制 (too broad) instead of 购买前询问 or 儿童购买需家长同意 when accurate
  • English badge headlines preserved on zh-Hans screenshots — "Ask to Buy" with no Chinese benefit line beside it
  • Overlay text overflow — long English parental-approval captions pasted into short screenshot callout zones truncate on device
  • Conflating 购买前询问 with 屏幕使用时间 — Ask to Buy is purchase approval; Screen Time is usage limits — different buyer intent and keywords
  • Conflating 购买前询问 with 家庭共享 family-plan copy — Ask to Buy is the approval gate; Share with Family is shared-access marketing — different frames
  • Conflating parental purchase approval with in-app PIN gates — system Ask to Buy spans Family Sharing child accounts; in-app gates stay inside your binary unless your listing shows both
  • Inconsistent vocabulary between listing description, promotional text, and screenshot captions when all three mention Ask to Buy or parental purchase approval
